meta.name: scam-no-comic-rebuild-queue
meta.purpose: Rebuild scam city pages that have no comic associated. These pages predate the current scam-page-builder spec — many use older narrative/lint conventions and lack the placeholders the generator now emits. Cron runner picks first status=pending entry by lowest priority, runs the scam-page-builder skill (Steps 1–12) as a rewrite, marks complete on PR-merge or failed on exception.
meta.rebuild_mode: pre-book-ready (Step 1 outcome 3 — fresh rewrite of an existing pre-book-ready page)

cron.expected_throughput: 1 page per 30 min = 2 pages/hour, ~4.7 days to drain 219 remaining pending
cron.rationale: Conservative 1-page batch per cron tick, fired every 30 min. Caps token spend per tick (~$25) while keeping forward progress steady. Bump batch size or shorten cadence once consistent quality is established.
